blockingFindings.title: Undefined expectedIssueCodes makes R7 test non-executable
blockingFindings.issue: The loop destructures `expectedIssue` but calls `assertIssueCodes(result, expectedIssueCodes)`. `expectedIssueCodes` is not defined in that scope, so the test throws before it can verify any producer-completion surface behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Destructure `expectedIssueCodes` from each surface case, or pass the destructured variable consistently to `assertIssueCodes`.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A non-executable spec-local test blocks implementation because it cannot validate the R7 acceptance coverage it claims.

blockingFindings.title: R4 readiness test expects incomplete requirements after marking all requirements done
blockingFindings.issue: The test writes `baseSpec("done")` before the `pending` validation, then expects `requirement-status-incomplete`. That contradicts the fixture state: both requirements are already marked done.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Use a spec fixture with at least one non-done requirement for the `requirement-status-incomplete` assertion, then switch to `baseSpec("done")` only for the final ready case.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The test encodes an incorrect implementation premise and would reject a correct implementation that treats all done requirements as complete.
